name: Get Out Of The Woods
detailed_description:
Have you ever put family and dreams in the balance? What if one affects another? Meet the Clocko's hen family and decide for yourself who deserves your trust and who you would avoid. Or maybe first impressions are deceiving, aren't they?

Investigate an old mystery or simply stroll around the farm, while each choice carefully watched over by your family. Feel the fleeting freedom you don't own.

As they say it's good where we are not, but in a foreign forest the main thing is not to lose yourself. What can a little bird do? Tame a predator? Save an innocent life? Investigate a crime? All you need to remember: you can't jump above your head.

Get Out Of The Woods is a non-linear visual novel that explores social conflicts familiar to many. Immerse yourself in the story, make decisions and empathize with the characters. Look closely, there are mysteries everywhere and everyone has secrets!

The game is divided into 3 chapters.

Chapter 1

Each action you take forms the character of the protagonist and sets the direction of the further plot. Witness the first conflict that will change Clocko's life and choose whether her strategy will be diplomacy or she will fight it out.

In Chapter 1 you'll find:

4 endings

Battle system

Moving around the farm map

Unique soundtracks and lots of CG art

Chapter 2

Each decision made earlier forms a game-changing scenario of the second chapter. We offer you 5 unique stories! Clocko faces new challenges, she learns the price of freedom, betrayal, and also has to decide who she can rely on in the new world. Each step could be decisive for the finale.

Chapter 3

The final chapter will lead you to a thrilling climax of the story. Here the juvenile hen is faced with the results of her actions in attempts to jump over her head. This chapter will answer the questions, can Clocko find harmony, justice and her place in the world? Or will she have to pay a high price for her dreams?

short_description: Life is easier when you're a small creature on a farm. Everything is decided for you, and your fate is written out until the very end. Sounds like a fairy tale... or maybe a nightmare? Enjoy the peaceful times. You'll never leave it, because you're safe here... Or are you?
